ranks.title: Ranks
ranks.change: Choose the exercise for the ranks
ranks.infoStandard: Every exercise has a standard. Your best set is compared with it: the standard is level 50, double it is level 100.
ranks.infoLevel: Each muscle gets its level from your three best exercises, your overall level from the 13 main muscles. Bigger muscles count more.
ranks.infoFair: Body weight and sex are taken into account. After 12 weeks off, a level drops slowly, but it never disappears.
ranks.infoExample: The line under each rank shows roughly what it takes in one exercise, at your usual reps: the one you pick above the ranks, otherwise the one you do most. Without workouts it shows the bench press as an example.
